recent_trades.summary: Trimming SLB as US-Iran peace deal will suppress oil prices, undermining the energy services thesis.

recent_trades.summary: Initiating HON position following board approval of Aerospace spin-off, a concrete corporate action catalyst that unlocks value.

My last action was a SELL on 2026-05-20, but the spin-off approval is specific new information that materially changes the investment thesis. The stock is trading near 30-day highs (~$229) with positive momentum. Sizing at 5% given this is early-stage and the full value unlock will take time.

This is still a moderate-sized starter rather than a full position because the stock is close to short-term highs and I do not want to chase aggressively intraday. Trimming modestly from 13.86% to ~12% generates ~$2,100 cash, reducing concentration in the name while retaining significant upside exposure. Sentiment is -0.15 negative.
